title: Ends Too Soon
style: UK garage-pop with skippy two-step rhythm, punchy offbeat bass, clipped handclaps, and a breezy midtempo bounce; verse rides sparse keys and rubbery sub, pre-chorus opens with rising synth air and doubled ad-libs, chorus hits with wide chord stabs and chanty group replies. Close-mic lead with casual spoken phrasing, layered doubles on key lines, quick delay throws, and small ear-candy fills like reverse sweeps and vinyl crackle. Bright, glossy, and cheeky in the mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You turned up late, still lookin' peak
Mum said "safe", now I'm on the seat
Got a full mad score, that means sweet
Two-step round when the low bass creeps

Got mates that chat like, "that's bare"
And I said, "for real?" with a side-eye stare
Tea on the table, chips in the bag
You called me "bruv" and I lost my tag

[Pre-Chorus]
You talk that way, I talk that way
Nah, it's all calm, we just say what we say
From "cheers" to "mate", it runs in the veins
One little phrase and the whole room swings

[Chorus]
Safe, safe, safe, that's the vibe
You know the drill, just roll with the tide
Proper cheeky, and a bit too much
Say it like that and I feel that buzz

Safe, safe, safe, don't act brand new
Say "gutted" once and I know that's true
From "peng" to "mug", from "buzzin'" to "clart"
UK slang got a whole big heart

[Verse 2]
You said "I'm skint", I said "same"
Till payday lands and we do it again
Your mate was "wasteman", mine was "leng"
Both of us laugh when the group chat flames

Can't be arsed, that's the daily line
But we're out by eight and we're right on time
"Not gonna lie" with a knowing grin
Then "innit" hits and we're all in

[Pre-Chorus]
You talk that way, I talk that way
Nah, it's all calm, we just say what we say
From "peak" to "peng", from "sorted" to "safe"
One little phrase and the mood just changed

[Chorus]
Safe, safe, safe, that's the vibe
You know the drill, just roll with the tide
Proper cheeky, and a bit too much
Say it like that and I feel that buzz

Safe, safe, safe, don't act brand new
Say "gutted" once and I know that's true
From "peng" to "mug", from "buzzin'" to "clart"
UK slang got a whole big heart

[Bridge]
If you're lost, I'll translate quick
But half the fun is the way we speak
One word lands and the whole place sings
Little bits of us in ordinary things

[Final Chorus]
Safe, safe, safe, that's the vibe
You know the drill, just roll with the tide
Proper cheeky, and a bit too much
Say it like that and I feel that buzz

Safe, safe, safe, don't act brand new
Say "gutted" once and I know that's true
From "peng" to "mug", from "buzzin'" to "clart"
UK slang got a whole big heart
